links.outcome: AI chest X-ray diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity, specificity versus radiologist reference in local primary care
links.effect: Average accuracy 0.95 (95% CI 0.92; 0.98), sensitivity 0.48 (95% CI 0.30; 0.66), specificity 0.98 (95% CI 0.97; 0.99); lower sensitivity for mediastinum, vessels and bone conditions.
links.quote: Analysing the validity of the AI algorithm, the average accuracy was 0.95 (95% CI 0.92; 0.98), the sensitivity was 0.48 (95% CI 0.30; 0.66) and the specificity was 0.98 (95% CI 0.97; 0.99).

screen.reason: This is an external validation study assessing the diagnostic accuracy of an AI algorithm on prospective clinical chest X-rays compared to radiologists, but it does not evaluate a specific deployment practice or guardrail comparison.
